children.textContent: The Roots of Moments With Mrs. T
were planted in 2019 when Tieshia recognized a deeper calling within herself — a desire to help others move beyond pain, uncertainty, and past trauma.

, after completing extensive coursework and achieving Life Coach certification, Moments With Mrs. T is the culmination of personal experiences, professional training, and an unwavering passion for people.

children.textContent: At Moments With Mrs. T, we aren’t just another coaching service — I am your partner in transformation. My approach is uniquely personal, blending professional techniques with the powerful touch of lived experience. I don’t just guide you — I walk with you, helping you make sense of life’s complexities with compassion and clarity.
— lifting my clients' spirits daily while offering realistic, actionable strategies for long-term success.
Your trauma does not define you.
Growth is a journey, not a race.
Every moment is a new opportunity to heal.
You are never alone in your struggle.
